source_refs.note: 2- Cloning of Recombinant Vector: a main subheading of 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 158-159.

blocks.text: Recombinant DNA (vector) aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein incubate kiye jate hain. Bacterial cells recombinant DNA ko andar le lete hain. Incubate kiye gaye sab bacteria taqseem ho kar bacterial clones (aik jaise bacteria ke groups) banate hain, jin mein gene of interest ki bilkul aik jaisi copies, yaani clones, bhi hoti hain.
